paper_record.title: Manipulation of localized excitons in CrPS$_4$ by temperature and magnetic field
paper_record.abstract: Layered van der Waals magnetic semiconductors provide a versatile platform for exploring excitonic phenomena intertwined with spin and lattice degrees of freedom, enabling excitons to act as sensitive probes of magnetic order. CrPS$_4$ is a layered antiferromagnetic semiconductor that hosts rich excitonic features whose microscopic origin and connection to magnetic ordering remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigate the electronic and excitonic properties of bulk CrPS$_4$ using a combination of many-body perturbation theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and photoluminescence-based experiments. Our calculations establish CrPS$_4$ as a direct-gap semiconductor with a bandgap of 2.48~eV in the antiferromagnetic phase. Several sub-bandgap excitonic transitions are predicted by theory, comprising multiple spin-allowed excitons and an additional spin-flip excitation, predominantly localized on the Cr$^{3+}$ ions. Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent optical measurements reveal thermally driven exciton redistribution among localized states and identify characteristic energy shifts that provide clear optical signatures of magnetic phase transitions in CrPS$_4$. These results provide new insights into the excitonic transitions of antiferromagnets and suggest potential routes for all-optical sensing and light-driven control of their magnetic order.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文结合多体微扰理论、动力学平均场理论与光致发光实验，揭示了二维反铁磁半导体CrPS4中局域激子的起源及其随温度和磁场的演化规律。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work combines many-body perturbation theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and photoluminescence experiments to reveal the origin of localized excitons in the 2D antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrPS4 and their manipulation by temperature and magnetic fields.

problem.zh: 澄清二维反铁磁半导体CrPS4的带隙大小争议，并阐明其亚带隙激子跃迁的微观起源及其与磁有序的耦合机制。
problem.en: To resolve the debate over the bandgap of the 2D antiferromagnetic semiconductor CrPS4 and clarify the microscopic origin of its sub-bandgap excitonic transitions and their coupling to magnetic order.

approach.zh: 采用准粒子自洽GW方法与动力学平均场理论进行第一性原理计算，并结合变温、变磁场的光致发光及光致发光激发光谱实验进行验证。
approach.en: Combining first-principles calculations using quasiparticle self-consistent GW and dynamical mean-field theory with temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent photoluminescence and photoluminescence excitation spectroscopy.

main_takeaway.zh: 确定了CrPS4在反铁磁相下为2.48 eV的直带隙半导体，证实其1.4 eV附近的激子跃迁主要为自旋允许跃迁，且这些局域激子能灵敏地指示磁相变。
main_takeaway.en: CrPS4 is established as a direct-gap semiconductor with a 2.48 eV bandgap in the AFM phase, with its 1.4 eV excitons identified as predominantly spin-allowed, serving as sensitive optical signatures of magnetic phase transitions.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为理解二维磁性半导体中的激子-磁性耦合提供了清晰的微观图像，并为基于反铁磁材料的全光传感和磁控器件开发奠定了基础。
why_it_matters.en: This study provides a clear microscopic picture of exciton-magnetism coupling in 2D magnetic semiconductors, laying the groundwork for all-optical sensing and control of magnetic order in antiferromagnets.

reason.zh: 澄清了CrPS4带隙大小及激子自旋性质的长期争议，并定量解释了激子随温度和磁场的异常移动。
reason.en: It resolves the long-standing controversy regarding the bandgap and exciton spin nature in CrPS4, quantitatively explaining the anomalous temperature and magnetic field dependencies.

reason.zh: 该工作关注二维范德华磁性材料的激子调控，结合了先进的计算与精细的光学表征，非常符合Nano Letters的发表范围。
reason.en: The paper investigates exciton manipulation in 2D van der Waals magnetic materials using advanced calculations and optical characterization, which fits well within the scope of Nano Letters.
